prerequisites.instruction: A Google Cloud project, enabled Gmail API, consent configuration and a suitable OAuth client for the actual host.
An eligible Google account and any Workspace administrator permission required for the selected scopes.

blockers: No Gmail implementation artifact is retained; quickstart sample code is not an integration package.
Production OAuth verification, refresh/revoke handling and requested operations must be resolved.
